title: Add Jest coverage for the admin-gated Field CRUD lifecycle
description: server/routes/fields.js (17 routes total) has zero test coverage per TESTING_GAPS.md Priority 1. Scoping this atomic task to the admin-gated write path only (POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id) plus the 403 gate — the read/search endpoints (GET /, /cities, /map, /search, /type/:type) and the crowd-report endpoints (/:id/analytics, /:id/report) are separate atomic tasks, not this one (keeps the diff reviewable and avoids mixing read-only and write-path concerns in one file). Follow the exact pattern in server/tests/usersMe.test.js: jest.mock('../utils/auth') with a mock-token map exposing both an admin and a non-admin req.user (requireAdmin from ../utils/admin reads req.user.isAdmin — see .cursor/rules/00-core-invariants.mdc and server/docs/agents/auth_pitfalls.md, never hardcode it), jest.mock the two background workers, { app } from '../index', real prisma from '../services/gameService', prisma.$connect() + cleanup via afterAll(prisma.field.deleteMany) scoped to fixture IDs only. Cover: (1) POST /api/fields as non-admin is 403 and creates nothing; (2) POST /api/fields as admin with valid { name, location, type } creates a field and returns 201 with the mapped shape (type lowercased to 'open'/'closed', favoritesCount/upcomingGamesCount present); (3) POST /api/fields missing a required field (name/location/type) is 400, no row created; (4) PUT /api/fields/:id as admin updates only the supplied fields (partial update — verify an omitted field is unchanged); (5) DELETE /api/fields/:id as admin removes the row (confirm via a following GET returning 404).
